title: Elitewheels Marvel 50D II disc brake carbon road wheelset
notes: Official specification table: 50 mm depth, 23 mm inner and 31 mm outer width, ETRTO-compliant reduced hooks, clincher/tubeless, 1,500 ±30 g pair without tubeless valves and rim tape (both listed as installed), 120 kg limit including rider, bike, gear and accessories, Motion hub with 4 pawls and S&S ceramic bearings, Alpina Ultralite Aero spokes 21F/24R, Center Lock, 12x100/12x142 mm, compatible tires 700x28-45C. US$839 on the official direct store, which advertises free shipping and customs duties for US/EU/UK/Australia. No maximum tire pressure or mainland China price is published.
